intro: Ask a question, write a document, look at numbers, or make a picture.
ffmpegLater: You can continue now and install ffmpeg later. The Edit screen shows the same guide until it is found.
keyHelp: Open {gatewayName}, copy a key, and paste it here. It stays on this computer.
tryIntro: Start in Chat. The others stay in the menu.

chat.title: Ask something
chat.hint: A plan, a question, or a reply you need to send.

document.title: Write a document
document.hint: Turn notes into a page you can keep.

finance.title: Look at numbers
finance.hint: A budget, cash flow, or a short brief.

images.title: Make a picture
images.hint: Describe what you want to see.

gate.invalidKey: That key didn't work. Check it at {gatewayName} and paste it again.
gate.unreachable: We couldn't reach {gatewayName}. Check your internet connection and try again.
gate.error: Something went wrong. Wait a moment and try again.

desks.title: Or open another desk
desks.failed: Could not open that desk. Try again.

components.title: Setting up {productName}
components.description: Adding the local reader for PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and e-book files. Every document is read on this machine; nothing is uploaded.
components.done: The local document reader is ready.
components.alreadyRunning: Another window is already setting this up; it will finish on its own.
components.worksWithout: {productName} works without it — documents are read by a simpler local reader until it is installed.

errors.offline: No connection, so the reader could not be downloaded.
errors.integrity_mismatch: The download did not match its checksum, so it was thrown away.
errors.unpack_failed: The download could not be unpacked.
errors.probe_failed: The reader was installed but would not load.
errors.unsupported_platform: There is no reader build for this operating system.
errors.busy: Another window is already setting this up.
errors.unknown: Setting up the reader did not finish.
